data.title: 平冢静 · 沿海公路的副驾落日吹风
data.description: 千叶沿海悬崖公路上敞篷跑车飞驰，暮色晚霞将天际染成金红。黑色长发在海风中肆意飞扬，平冢静一手握着方向盘，另一只手紧紧扣住你的手，笑容肆意洒脱又无比深情。
data.location: coastal cliff highway overlooking the shimmering Pacific Ocean at dusk
data.action: sitting in open convertible on coastal highway at sunset, black hair whipping in the sea breeze, laughing freely while resting hand on partner gear-shifting hand
data.lighting: brilliant crimson and gold sunset reflecting on the car hood and waves
data.mood: cinematic freedom, adult lover romance, breathtaking coastal sunset
data.promptProse: Driving an open convertible along coastal cliffs at sunset, Shizuka laughs freely with windblown black hair, holding partner hand with glowing joy.
data.animaCaption: Shizuka Hiratsuka driving convertible happily along sunset coast.
